violation_type.typical_finding: All  playground I observed,  the roof on one of the structures is chipped and/or broken that could injure a child. ( picture taken

finding_variants.text: All  playground I observed,  the roof on one of the structures is chipped and/or broken that could injure a child. ( picture taken
Observed the playground fence with broken sharp pieces exposed that are accessible to children.
Play structure on the playground has a protruding nail that's accessible to children.
Play structure in the playground has multiple broken and cracked areas on the walking platform, that are dangerous and could cause injury if a child were to fall onto these areas.
The garage outside and slide stairs have sharp edges that are accessible to children.

A nail was sticking out of the shelve in the toddler room.    In the 3 year old room the shelve was missing the plastic boarder on the edges exposing the pressed board.    Note: Pictures were taken. The nail was removed and the other shelf had tape put on the edges to keep them from getting sharp and to remove access to the wood.
